title: Beef Birria Tacos
description: A flavorful and comforting Mexican dish, Beef Birria Tacos are tender, juicy, and rich in flavor. Served with a side of fresh cilantro, onion, and lime.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, brown the beef over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Mexican oregano, cumin, and dried ancho chilies to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef for 2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Shred the beef with two forks and add the lime juice and salt to the pot.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the shredded beef onto a tortilla and topping with your desired toppings.
